signal.primary: MIX long/cash over the calendar day before and day of the scheduled announcement, then flatten at next actual open
signal.control: same fixed two-day rule shifted7calendar days earlier, with cancellation evaluated as known then; never promotable after outcomes

limitations: One fixed scheduled-event premium hypothesis. Daily two-day window includes the announcement and aftermath; NOT an exact replication or falsification of the24h pre-FOMC drift. No press-conference subset selection.

Original dated schedule pages and public press-conference transcript are current archive copies, not cryptographically witnessed contemporaneous receipts or a proven complete revision chain. Conservative daily lag does not establish strict PIT.
March2020cancellation applies only after its public spoken date; the earlier control may already have traded and must not be deleted. Unscheduled meetings do not become advance signals.

Next actual open, expired-entry cancellation, integer size, rolls and halt carry use unchanged V64/V78 daily proxy accounting. No filtering on future exit availability; exposure can last beyond the event on a halt.

Development history already seen; no independent holdout claim, cash yield,2026market data, broker/live/demo or expanded AlgoPack admission. Five-percent component gate is not the original20-50percent income objective.
